events.verdict: Ball (CHI) swipes his arm down and makes contact with Ball's (CHA) left arm, which affects his driving shot attempt at the basket.
Vucevic (CHI) firms up over his left leg and marginal contact occurs as Green (CHA) attempts to defend around the pick.
Dosunmu (CHI) extends his left hand forward and makes contact with Ball's (CHA) head/face, which affects Ball's SQBR with the ball.
After Vucevic (CHI) releases from his screening position, Green (CHA) initiates contact with Vucevic that impedes his ability to roll towards the basket.
Williams (CHA) legally blocks Ball's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Williams (CHA) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Chicago.
Ball (CHA) legally contests Ball's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
LaVine (CHI) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
L:aVine (CHI) legally contests Smith Jr.'s (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Green (CHA) and Vucevic (CHI) engage in the paint and the contact away from the ball is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Williams (CHA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Williams brings his right hand into the ball and legally dislodges it away LaVine (CHI). Neither team is imminently in possession of the ball at the time of the whistle and a jump ball is conducted at center court to determine possession. The resumption of play rule is properly adjudicated.
Ball (CHA) grasps and promptly releases Dosunmu's (CHI) jersey as the two players disengage during the jump ball.
Dosunmu (CHI) grasps and swiftly releases Green's (CHA) right wrist during the loose ball opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Dosunmu (CHI) legally contests Bridges' (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Williams (CHA) extends his arms forward as he leans into Vucevic's (CHI) space and Williams delivers contact that affects Vucevic's trajectory as he goes into the air to pursue the loose ball.
Ball (CHI) reaches in for the ball and makes contact with Micic's (CHA) left arm, which affects Micic's control of the ball.
Ball (CHI) and Bridges (CHA) engage during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Bridges (CHA) legally contests Vucevic's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Green (CHA) legally contests LaVine's (CHI) jump shot, making 'high-five' contact after the ball is released.
Diabate's (CHA) arms come out slightly as he releases away from Ball (CHI) during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Diabate (CHA) is moving back to his left when Dosunmu (CHI) recovers the loose ball while airborne and marginal body contact occurs during Dosunmu's put-back attempt near the basket.
